description: Hi, this is EchoSphere. I’m a software engineering student who loves data science.  NASA makes amazing visualizations of our planet, but you have to see them to get them. So I’m building the Earth Information Jukebox: a web app that turns real NASA data into music anyone can hear, including blind and low-vision users. Some tracks are chill; some are a bit too hot🔥. My goal is to let anyone hear how our planet is changing. 🎧
